note: Chapter XVII full pass in the Book I painting style (Ian, 17 Nov), shot-sized.
style: A cinematic Romantic oil painting of 1893 in the exact manner of the reference painting: academic realism with dramatic chiaroscuro, warm amber lamplight and firelight against deep brown-black shadow, a cool blue window, atmospheric haze and shafts of light, deep architectural space, rich painterly brushwork. One single painting filling the whole 16:9 frame, no text, signature, border or black bars.

beats.text: Shot: wide. The study in fading afternoon light: the doctor absorbed in bundles of typewritten diaries spread over his desk, the window going blue, lamp not yet lit.
Shot: medium. At the door of her small sitting-room the young woman meets the doctor; her eyes are red with weeping, the phonograph on the table behind her.
Shot: close. Close: the young woman lays her hand on the doctor's hand on the table and speaks gravely; warm lamplight on the two hands and her face.

Shot: wide, far. The study at night from the doorway: two small figures at a desk in one pool of lamplight, a typewriter and phonograph, the rest of the room in deep shadow, blue moonlight at the window.
Shot: medium. The young woman lies back in her chair, pale and spent, the phonograph earpieces in her lap; the doctor has jumped up with a horrified face and pours brandy from a decanter.
Shot: medium. In the hall of the asylum the young doctor shakes hands with the energetic white-haired young man; morning light through a tall window.
Shot: looking in from outside. From the dark garden, an upstairs window of the asylum lit gold: inside, a young woman types while a white-haired young man sorts papers beside her; rain on the glass.
Shot: medium. A bare whitewashed asylum cell: a patient in a rough shirt sits placidly on the edge of an iron bed, hands folded, while the doctor watches from the doorway with a lamp.
Shot: wide. A drawing-room at the asylum on a grey afternoon: the young woman receives a tall young nobleman in black mourning and a lean Texan with a moustache; fire in the grate.
Shot: medium. The tall clean-shaven young nobleman in mourning holds a thick typed manuscript and asks the young woman if she wrote it all; she nods gravely.
Shot: medium. The tall young nobleman has turned away and covered his face with his hands; the Texan lays a hand on his shoulder before quietly leaving; the young woman watches with pity.
Shot: wide, far. The drawing-room from the far end, grey light at tall windows and a low fire: on a sofa the young nobleman weeps, his head on the young woman's shoulder.
Shot: close. Close: the young woman and the young nobleman clasp hands, his eyes wet, hers kind; firelight.
Shot: medium. By a corridor window in evening light, the lean Texan with a moustache stoops to kiss the young woman's hand.
